segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making the time. I wanted to walk through the updated quote for the calibration workflow package and make sure the seat count and start date line up with what your team needs.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that works. We’re still at 24 users total. Eighteen technicians, four supervisors, and two read-only seats for quality.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. The quote I sent has 22 full seats and 2 read-only seats, annual term, starting March 1st. Total is $38,640 for the year, with implementation at $4,500 one-time.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And implementation includes the asset import and the two admin training sessions, right?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. Asset import from your current spreadsheet, one sandbox review, and two 90-minute admin trainings. If we kick off the week of March 4th, go-live would be targeted for April 8th.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That timing is fine. Billing-wise, can you split the annual subscription and the implementation fee onto separate invoice lines? Same invoice is okay.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, same invoice with separate line items. Payment terms are net 30, and the renewal would be March 1st next year unless you give 30 days’ notice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sounds good. Send the order form over today and I’ll route it to procurement. They usually turn these around in three or four business days.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll send it over with the quote attached and the April 8th go-live noted. Anything else you want changed before I do that?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: No, that should cover it. Thanks.
